description:
Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

opencodex is a universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Grok Build: a local proxy that lets them run on many different LLM providers from a single port, translating between API wire formats.

Features:
- Works with Anthropic, Google, xAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Azure, DeepSeek, Ollama, and 40+ other built-in providers.
- Supports streaming, tool calls, reasoning, and images.
- Handles OAuth logins and a ChatGPT account pool.
- Native model picker in the Codex app, sub-agents, and search/vision sidecars.
Published to npm as @bitkyc08/opencodex@2.100.5 with dist-tag latest.
New Features
- Add Kimi (Responses) as its own row under the Kimi login (#8798)
- Add GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra and upgrade subagent defaults (#8893)
Bug Fixes
- Stream the Linux listener table so a busy host is not refused (#8855)
- Refuse Anthropic redirects, keep chat caller restrictions, gate explicit SSH routes (#8868)
- Fence retained native login by account identity (#8808)
- Bind model discovery to Google destinations (#8802)
- Yield within indexed row decoding and aggregation (#8800)
- Bound WebSocket event retention (#8801)
- Keep unbounded tool catalog admission linear (#8804)
- Bound eager tool warning diagnostics (#8810)
- Keep a child's reasoning replay out of the parent's record (#8634)
- Fail closed when stream replay classification fails (#8805)
- Preserve literal spans in citation escaping (#8811)
- Bound duplicate citation title updates (#8813)
- R5 platform and test-hygiene lane (zh-CN/ko-KR checked stop, Windows git config, test network guard) (#8870)
- Keep localized schtasks denials and harden the test egress guard (#8870 follow-up) (#8872)
- Avoid Gemini rejection of tool catalog guidance (#8792)
- Keep the measured schema keywords on claude-opus-5.5 (#8756)
- Honor empty completion retries for Chat turns (#8869)
- Repair dev after the triage merges (ws+unix in the test network guard, Spanish adapters parity) (#8874)
- Carry combo hop, attempt timing, Devin admission and Anthropic pool failover fixes (#8871)
- Aside/Prime send system instead of developer; name DashScope's developer-role rejection (#8864) (#8867)
- Honor dotted Devin override keys for hyphenated requests (#8871 follow-up) (#8875)
- R3 triage — Devin Claude Code rewrites, OpenCode Go include, Command Code root schemas, JEV continuation effort (#8873)
- Restore never reverts config.toml changes made after injection (#8878)
Chores
- Assert the callback redirect against the port actually bound, not a fixed 54545 (#8854)
- Hold live waits for the MCP concurrency bound (#8851)
- Gate post-proof timeout fixtures on data receipt (#8834)
- Hold a racing uninstall to its guarantee whatever its outcome (#8379) (#8876)
- Read only complete capture lines in the MCP queue fixture (#8879)
- Scope a GUI build-tool exception for GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf (#8895)
